decisions.reason: The missing contract-ID decision does not change the supplied dates or their application; the separate date instruction from message 34 is already represented.
Contract-ID availability does not alter the allocated-budget values or their source.
The missing contract IDs do not change the personnel calculation or budget-gap treatment.
The allocation rule is established by a separate clause in message 34 and is unaffected by whether contract IDs were provided.
The contract-ID decision does not change the seven-week Annex B requirement.
The absence of an NCA contract ID does not change the established equivalence between NCA and NH.
Message 34's instruction to use 286R is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, and no additional update or removal is required.
The missing contract IDs provide no concrete change to the documented session weekdays or time slots.
Contract-ID availability does not affect the requirement to sign the subcontractor section.
